delta: 모바일 화면의 고정 밴드는 개수가 아니라 그 밴드가 일을 하는지로 판정된다 — 하단 고정 밴드를 (a) 지금 왜 진행 불가한지 문장으로 말하고 (b) 눌리면 다음 미완료 지점으로 이동시키는 상태기계(waiting/stop/revise/ready)로 만들면 3렌즈 동시 우위를 얻는다. disabled 버튼은 같은 자리에서 정보를 0으로 만든다. 반대로 종결 액션이 있는 화면에서 고정면을 전부 없애면 주 제스처의 확인 피드백이 스크롤 위쪽에 그려져 조작 시점에 안 보이게 된다.

delta: RN Web fontVariant:["tabular-nums"] applied to a text node that also contains the Won sign (₩) produces a visible horizontal-line-through-like rendering artifact across the whole string in this environment, distinct from any textDecorationLine in source. Not present when ₩ appears in the same round, same font stack, in plain body text WITHOUT tabular-nums. Until confirmed live (computed-style/DOM inspection, not just source reading), treat combining tabular-nums with non-Latin currency symbols as a rendering risk — verify visually, or style the numeral portion separately from the currency-symbol prefix (e.g. a separate Text node for the symbol without tabular-nums).
evidence: auto-native-r4 lens1 and lens2 independently flagged the artifact in candidate c (OrderHistoryScreen.tsx:170-172,243,426-431 — ₩ + fontVariant:["tabular-nums"]), visible in both c-390.png and c-768.png, neither pinned the mechanism (grep confirmed no textDecorationLine anywhere in the file). Orchestrator cross-checked candidate b (same round, same font/tokens stack) which renders ₩-prefixed prices extensively in data.ts body text WITHOUT tabular-nums and shows no artifact — isolates the trigger to the tabular-nums+₩ combination specifically, though the rendering-engine mechanism itself remains unconfirmed (source-reading only, no live DOM inspection).

delta: 완성도 다수결로 이긴 confirmation-flow 화면(X/a)은 r3가 확립한 '하단 밴드=상태기계(차단 문구+미해결 지점 점프)' 패턴을 단일 체크리스트에서 멀티스텝 위저드로 확장했을 뿐 아니라, 그 밴드와 차단 상태를 accessibilityRole="alert" + accessibilityLiveRegion="polite"로 승격해 상태 전환을 스크린리더에도 전달했다. 동일하게 종결 액션(에스크로 해제)을 가진 후보(Y/b)는 시각적으로 더 풍부했지만 상태 전환이 무음 DOM 교체였고(alert/liveRegion 전무) hitSlop도 더 작았다(4pt vs X 8pt) — 렌즈1(DNA·a11y 준수)·렌즈2(모바일 완성도) 모두에서 X에 졌다. 상태기계 밴드 패턴(r3)은 '차단 문구+점프'만으로는 불완전하고, 그 전환을 라이브리전으로 승격해야 완성도·접근성 양쪽에서 이긴다.

delta: The auto-native-r4 tabular-nums+₩ rendering artifact reproduces in a second, independent round with a refined mechanism: separating the ₩ symbol into its own sibling Text node is NOT sufficient if that sibling Text is still nested as a CHILD of a parent Text carrying fontVariant:["tabular-nums"] — RN Web cascades fontVariant down to nested Text children regardless of the child having its own style object, so the child ₩ Text still inherits tabular-nums and the strikethrough-like artifact persists. In this round, candidate a explicitly attempted the r4-documented mitigation (a comment claiming "the won sign lives in its own sibling Text node, never the same node as a tabular-nums numeral string") but implemented it as a nested child of the tabular-nums-styled parent Text, and all three independent judges visually confirmed the artifact was still present in both 390px and 768px screenshots. Candidate b in the same round avoided the defect entirely by never applying tabular-nums to any ₩-adjacent text. The correct fix is not proximity-as-sibling-node but nesting depth: the tabular-nums style must apply ONLY to a Text subtree that does not contain the ₩ glyph anywhere in its render tree, i.e. the ₩ Text must be a sibling at the same level as the tabular-nums Text under a shared non-styled wrapper (View or unstyled Text), not a child of it.
evidence: All 3 lenses independently found and cited the identical defect: lens1 traced PayoutsScreen.tsx:181-184 (balanceValue) and :144-148 (txnAmount) showing the won-sign Text nested inside the tabular-nums-styled parent (fontVariant declarations at :379,391,558), contradicting the fix comment at data.ts:172-173, and confirmed visually in a-390.png/a-768.png (every ₩ figure — 90,000/168,000/+168,000/-450,000/+520,000 — shows a strikethrough-like artifact). lens3 independently cross-referenced native/src/listing/ListingCreateScreen.tsx:47-67, which has its own WonText helper explicitly guarding against this exact pattern (comment: "the symbol and the numeral run always live in sibling Text nodes"), confirming this is a known, previously-solved-elsewhere failure mode that recurred here. lens2 independently flagged it as near-disqualifying for a ledger screen whose entire purpose is displaying trustworthy currency figures. Candidate b (same round) was cross-checked by lens1 as a clean counterexample: data.ts:170-176 renders ₩ prices extensively with zero tabular-nums usage anywhere in the file (grep-confirmed), and renders cleanly in b-390.png/b-768.png.

delta: The state-machine bottom-band idiom (blocked/ready/done + jump-to-unresolved-item, established r3->r5->r6c, L2) generalizes cleanly ACROSS DOMAINS when reapplied faithfully — a dispute/return screen (a genuinely different domain from seller identity verification) reused the same 3-state band, same jumpTo+scrollToIndex+onScrollToIndexFailed mechanics, and the same accessibilityRole=alert+accessibilityLiveRegion=polite promotion, and won lens1 (DNA compliance) and lens2 (mobile completeness) decisively on the strength of that correct reuse. But the SAME structural closeness that earned those two lenses win was independently read by lens3 (screen-type differentiation) as evidence the screen is not sufficiently novel relative to r6c, since not just the general principle but the specific implementation (state names, style block layout, control-flow shape) tracks closely. Both readings are correct simultaneously — this is not a judge disagreement to resolve but a real tension: the same axis (interaction-shell reuse) that the compliance/polish lenses reward as "correctly following an established pattern" is exactly what the differentiation lens is designed to penalize as "insufficiently new." No current delta or curation-criteria entry says where the line sits between the two.
evidence: lens1: "a...implements the fixed-bottom-band pattern exactly as the vaults strongest lesson prescribes...This is the only candidate that had occasion to demonstrate the alert/live-region requirement, and it does so correctly and completely." lens2: "The bottom band is a real three-state machine...This is the most sophisticated, genuinely-terminal-action chrome pattern of the three." lens3 (same round, same code): "the fixed-bottom-band state machine mechanics are close to a direct structural copy of r6-c, not just a shared documented idiom applied differently — Same three states with matching names/behavior...Same jump to unresolved item, expand, scroll control flow...essentially identical." All three cite the same file (DisputeCenterScreen.tsx:113-134,172-205,512-553,833-877) as their primary evidence, for opposite conclusions.

delta: [[GENERATION.md]] §4 접근성 보강 — 하단 상태기계 밴드(blocked/ready/done)의 상태 전환에 accessibilityRole="alert" + accessibilityLiveRegion="polite"를 다는 패턴이 3라운드 연속(r5 확립 → r6c 재현 → r7a 재현) 관찰됐다. 매 라운드 이 승격을 적용한 후보가 렌즈1(DNA/a11y 준수)에서 승리하거나 결정적 우위를 얻었고, 빠뜨린 동일 라운드 경쟁 후보(r5/b)는 그 결여만으로 감점됐다 — 종결액션이 있는 화면에서 이 승격은 선택이 아니라 사실상 필수 체크리스트 항목.
evidence: r5 lens1: "X(a)는 검증 차단 상태에 accessibilityRole=alert(:449,607) + 하단 밴드 accessibilityLiveRegion=polite(:599)까지 적용... Y(b)는 alert 롤이나 liveRegion이 전혀 없어 상태 전환이 스크린리더 관점에서 무음 DOM 교체". r7 lens1: "a...promotes the state transition to accessibilityRole=alert on both the blocked title(:533) and the done title(:515), wrapped in an accessibilityLiveRegion=polite band container(:512). This is the only candidate that had occasion to demonstrate the alert/live-region requirement, and it does so correctly and completely." r7 lens3 independently confirms r6c(SellerVerificationScreen.tsx:452-468)도 동일 패턴을 이미 갖고 있었다고 대조 — 3라운드 연속 재현.
